description: Source: Data Studio pages 1–2. Live governed PROD OLAP values; THB. Legacy profit means gross interest, before expenses.
sql: SELECT "Active Loans" FROM public.olap_portfolio_summary
name: Active Loans

description: Original formula preserved: days 0–6 versus days 8–14; day 7 is skipped. Includes today. No value when the previous period is zero.
sql:
WITH totals AS (
 SELECT coalesce(sum("Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER(WHERE "Payment Date" BETWEEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date-6 AND (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date),0) recent,
 coalesce(sum("Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER(WHERE "Payment Date" BETWEEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date-14 AND (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date-8),0) prior
 FROM public.olap_repayments_analytics
) SELECT (recent-prior)/NULLIF(prior,0) AS "7-Day Profit Growth %" FROM totals
name: 7-Day Profit Growth %

description: Gross interest received during the 30 Bangkok dates ending today. Original title typo corrected.
sql:
SELECT coalesce(sum("Interest Paid"::numeric),0) AS "Profit in Past 30 Days"
FROM public.olap_repayments_analytics WHERE "Payment Date" BETWEEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date-29 AND (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date
name: Profit in Past 30 Days

description: All-time gross interest received, using posted repayment allocations.
sql: SELECT coalesce(sum("Interest Paid"::numeric),0) AS "Interest Paid" FROM public.olap_repayments_analytics
name: Interest Paid

description: Borrower with the largest current outstanding principal, displayed using the source Description field. Stable Row ID breaks ties.
sql: SELECT "Description" AS "Top Borrower" FROM public.olap_borrowers_analytics WHERE "Hidden Flag" IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY "Total Outstanding Principal" DESC NULLS LAST, "Row ID" LIMIT 1
name: Top Borrower

description: Borrowers → Loans, joined by immutable Row ID / Ref Borrowers. Four named bars plus Others, as in the source. Each loan contributes once.
sql:
WITH amounts AS (
 SELECT b."Description" borrower,coalesce(sum(l."Outstanding Principal"),0) amount
 FROM public.olap_borrowers_analytics b
 LEFT JOIN public.olap_loans_analytics l ON l."Ref Borrowers"=b."Row ID"
 WHERE b."Hidden Flag" IS NOT TRUE GROUP BY b."Description"
), ranked AS (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST,borrower) n FROM amounts)
SELECT CASE WHEN n<=4 THEN borrower ELSE 'Others' END AS "Borrower",sum(amount) AS "Amount (THB)"
FROM ranked GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(CASE WHEN n<=4 THEN n ELSE 5 END)
name: Outstanding Principal by Borrower

description: Gross interest, last 30 dates including today. Repayments are aggregated per loan before joining Loans → Borrowers; no charge fan-out. Four named bars plus Others.
sql:
WITH per_loan AS (
 SELECT "Ref Loans",sum("Interest Paid"::numeric) amount FROM public.olap_repayments_analytics
 WHERE "Payment Date" BETWEEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date-29 AND (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date GROUP BY "Ref Loans"
), amounts AS (
 SELECT b."Description" borrower,sum(r.amount) amount
 FROM per_loan r JOIN public.olap_loans_analytics l ON l."Row ID"=r."Ref Loans"
 JOIN public.olap_borrowers_analytics b ON b."Row ID"=l."Ref Borrowers"
 WHERE b."Hidden Flag" IS NOT TRUE GROUP BY b."Description"
), ranked AS (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST,borrower) n FROM amounts)
SELECT CASE WHEN n<=4 THEN borrower ELSE 'Others' END AS "Borrower",sum(amount) AS "Amount (THB)"
FROM ranked GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(CASE WHEN n<=4 THEN n ELSE 5 END)
name: 30 Days Profit by Borrower

description: Stored daily snapshots, aggregated by Snapshot Date. The original fixed cash-pool reference is ฿120,000; it is not the live cash-pool balance.
sql: SELECT "Snapshot Date" AS "Date",sum("Outstanding Principal EOD"::numeric) AS "Amount (THB)" FROM public."Daily Analytics" WHERE true [[AND {{report_date}}]] GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
name: Daily Outstanding Principal

description: Stored daily snapshots, aggregated by Snapshot Date. Gross interest received; original ฿10,000 daily goal preserved.
sql: SELECT "Snapshot Date" AS "Date",sum("Interest Received"::numeric) AS "Amount (THB)" FROM public."Daily Analytics" WHERE true [[AND {{report_date}}]] GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
name: Daily Profit

description: Stored daily snapshots, aggregated by Snapshot Date. Uses Pending Charges EOD and excludes today, matching the original chart.
sql: SELECT "Snapshot Date" AS "Date",sum("Pending Charges EOD"::numeric) AS "Amount (THB)" FROM public."Daily Analytics" WHERE true AND "Snapshot Date" <> (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date [[AND {{report_date}}]] GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
name: Daily Overdue Charges (Excluding Today)

description: Available cash plus gross unsettled partner profit equals the legacy expected loan account balance. Source Statistics date field is Peak Cash Pool Date 30D.
sql:
SELECT 'Loan account' AS "Account", "Total Cash Pool"-"Outstanding Principal" AS "Available Cash", "Total Unsettled Profit" AS "Unsettled Profit"
FROM public.olap_portfolio_summary WHERE true [[AND {{report_date}}]]
name: Loan Account Balance Composition

description: Current outstanding principal by loan type; date control filters Loan Date, matching the original. Historical date selection does not calculate an as-of balance.
sql:
SELECT CASE "Loan Type" WHEN 'กำหนดวันชำระ' THEN 'กำหนดวันชำระ / Fixed Due Date' WHEN 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน' THEN 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน / Daily Interest' WHEN 'ผ่อนชำระรายวัน' THEN 'ผ่อนชำระรายวัน / Daily Installment' ELSE 'ไม่ทราบประเภท / Unknown' END AS "Loan Type",
sum("Outstanding Principal") AS "Principal (THB)" FROM public.olap_loans_analytics
WHERE true [[AND {{report_date}}]] GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
name: Outstanding Principal by Loan Type

description: Daily snapshot principal flows: issued positive, returned negative, matching the source Net Principle Returned formula. Zero-valued bars have no data label, following the source label-safe presentation.
sql:
SELECT "Snapshot Date" AS "Date",nullif(sum("Principal Issued"::numeric),0) AS "Principal Issued",-nullif(sum("Principal Returned"::numeric),0) AS "Principal Returned"
FROM public."Daily Analytics" WHERE true [[AND {{report_date}}]] GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
name: Principal Issued vs Principal Returned
